name: Kbd_ISR
note: INT 9 handler (code label): key[scancode&0x7f]=1 on RELEASE (break code) else 0; table 0x66e18

name: Spr_BlitClip
note: stub+body 0x100db: (src;x;y;w;h;skip;pad;page) clips x to 0..0x160 then Spr_Blit

name: Intro_PlaySample
note: stub+body 0x101d4: (n) INTRO.SAM slice n; SB: n 0-4 ch 1/2 alternating vol 6 rate 12000 one-shot; n 6 ch0 loop vol 4; n 5/7 not handled. GUS: freq 0x12e/0x13b/0x107; n 6 loop from +0x251c

name: Intro_SoundInit
note: stub+body 0x10471: GUS (0x40000) or SB (0x50000; 40000 Hz); loads intro.sam 0x3f404 bytes; SB converts to unsigned; starts loop sample 6

name: Intro_SoundShutdown
note: stub+body 0x106d8: stops DMA; restores IRQ; frees sample buffer (DAT_67210=0)

name: main
note: stub+body 0x107c8: loads data; mode X; scene state machine DAT_67018 (1..7) until ESC/D; text credits; FRAME overlays; see sound_intro.md

name: Intro_ExitWaitKey
note: ghidra fragment of main after the loop: if credits text was visible -> Intro_Cleanup; else waits for another ESC (contains dead menu code: PLAYERS/GAMES/ABORT)

name: Intro_Cleanup
note: fade out; text mode; sound shutdown; CD stop; restore INT 9; free buffers; return 0

name: Intro_DrawCredits
note: stub+body 0x13ffe: (scroll;page) draws credit string DAT_60368 (0..10) centred with widths table 0x6075d; '\' = newline (+12 px); y 100 or 150 when logo/frames shown

name: Intro_ReadKey
note: stub+body 0x142ce: -1 ESC or scancode 0x20 released; 1 Up 2 Down 3 Left 4 Right 5 Enter; mouse polling when DAT_671f4 (never set)

name: Pal_Fade
note: stub+body 0x149b3: (dir) 0 = fade in 25 steps; 1 = fade out 26 steps; each step waits vsync; master palette 0x65c18

name: Text_DrawBig
note: stub+body 0x14a9c: (x;y;str;mode) big-font string; used by dead menu

name: CD_PlayTrackRaw
note: stub+body 0x14d10: (drive;track) device request 0x84 from track start for (next start - start) frames

name: CD_Check
note: stub+body 0x15475: 0 ok 1 no MSCDEX 2 old 3 not 15 tracks (unused)

name: CD_InitAndPlayTrack2
note: stub+body 0x15547: MSCDEX checks (printf on failure); reads TOC; plays track 2

name: Video_SetModeX
note: mode 13h then unchained 320x240 60 Hz; line pitch 0x60 bytes (384 px virtual); clears 256K; palette black

name: Video_PlotUnder
note: (x;y;colour;page) plot only if current pixel is 0 or 0x20..0x24 (city lights behind scenery)

name: Spr_Blit
note: (src;x;y;w;h;skip;pad;page) chunky source to mode X; 0 transparent

name: Video_FlipScroll
note: (scrollX;page) CRTC start = page(0/0x5a00)+x/4; pel pan (x&3)*2; waits vsync

name: Tile_DrawBand
note: (map;tilePtrs;band;plane;page) 2 tile rows (24 x 16x16) per band; band 7 = 1 row; tiles planar 4x0x40

name: Tile_ScrollMapLeft
note: rotates each of 16 map rows left by one tile (24 entries)

name: GUS_Detect
note: obj GUS driver (same as JS obj4)

name: SB_SpeakerOn
note: SB driver obj (same code as JS 0x3057c..)

name: Mixer_Update
note: same 4-channel mixer as JS Timer_ISR_SBMixer but polled from main loop (4x per frame)
